manualReview: All findings are design-system documentation advisories, not runtime or accessibility failures. Font-size equivalents (e.g. 0.8125rem = 13px at the 16px root), retained semantic color shades and specific logo/chart radii were reviewed against the rendered design. The canonical design document was expanded after this single scan. This is not a claim of a clean detector rescan. Contrast is separately checked in accessibility.json; keyboard and reflow in design-check.json.
